checklist.evidence: Large white bold SYSTEM FAILURE is legible in every frame.
Colour-fringed block displacement and RGB split on the title in many frames, strongest at 0.29s and around 5s.
The background is clean black with no visible scanlines, noise, rolling bars or screen distortion. It reads as a glitchy title, not a broken TV.

problems: There is no broken-TV environment. The black background has no static, scanlines, roll bars or screen flicker, and the glitch is confined to the text.
The red ghost copy is offset to the right and shows as a dark red slab. It looks like a misregistered duplicate, not a deliberate chromatic split.
The layout is static and the title sits small in a wide empty frame. Frame use is weak, with large empty areas above and below.
The glitch is mild and often clean, so frames like 3.79s and 6.12s look like a normal title. The intensity doesn't read as a system failure.
The subtitle is small and low-impact, and the red on black contrast is moderate.
judge.verdict: The title is legible and the glitch effects are visible. It looks like a glitchy text card, not a broken TV, because the screen itself is never distorted. The user would likely ask for more TV-style distortion and a stronger look.
